sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of glycerol phenylbutyrate during breastfeeding. Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in a breastfed infant, breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with glycerol phenylbutyrate.
